title.zh: 给 AI Agent 用的专属基础设施
title.en: Agent-Native Infrastructure (Built for Machines, Not Humans)

old_assumption.zh: 邮箱、浏览器、支付和身份验证都是围绕人类图形界面（GUI）设计的。
old_assumption.en: Email, browsers, payments, and auth are designed around human GUIs.

new_shift.zh: AI Agent 正在成为软件的新一类用户，它们不需要好看的 UI，需要的是极简 API、沙盒与独立身份。
new_shift.en: AI agents are becoming primary software users—they need headless APIs, sandboxes, and machine identities, not pretty dashboards.

zh: 列出 5 个目前完全为人类设计的互联网基础设施（如邮箱、日历、支付、客服），分析当使用者变成 AI Agent 时，原产品的最大摩擦点是什么，以及对应的极简 API 替代品该如何设计。
在 [你的技术栈/熟悉领域] 中，如果要为一个自主运行的 AI Agent 提供安全沙盒和权限审计层，最小的独立开发者 MVP 应该只做哪 3 个核心接口？
en: List 5 internet primitives built for humans (email, calendar, payments, auth) and explain what breaks when the user is an AI agent—plus how a headless API replacement should work.
In [Your Tech Stack/Domain], what are the 3 minimal endpoints needed to build an indie-friendly sandbox and permission layer for autonomous AI agents?

note.zh: 专为 AI Agent 设计的邮箱 API 基础设施
note.en: Email inbox API built specifically for AI agents

note.zh: 为 AI 生成代码提供安全隔离的云端代码沙盒
note.en: Open-source cloud sandboxes for AI-executed code

title.zh: 用完即弃的“一次性定制微软件”

old_assumption.zh: 写软件成本极高，所以每个程序都必须做成通用产品、长期维护并服务成千上万人。
old_assumption.en: Software is expensive to build, so every app must be generalized, maintained for years, and built for thousands.

new_shift.zh: 代码生成成本趋近于零后，为一次旅行、一次搬家或一次数据清洗花 10 分钟生成专属本地网页应用变得完全划算。
new_shift.en: With near-zero code generation cost, spinning up a bespoke local app for one trip, one move, or one dataset is now completely practical.

zh: 我最近需要处理一件一次性但很繁琐的事：[描述你的具体任务]。请帮我设计一个单文件 HTML/JS 本地微工具的极简规格，让我 10 分钟内生成并用完即弃。
盘点 [你的职业/生活场景] 中，哪些原本只能凑合用 Excel 做的临时任务，现在更适合用“一次性定制小网页”彻底解决？
en: I have a tedious one-off task: [Describe Your Task]. Spec out a single-file local HTML/JS micro-app I can generate in 10 minutes, use once, and discard.
In [Your Role/Life Context], which messy tasks people currently hack together in spreadsheets are better solved by disposable, bespoke single-use web apps?

note.zh: “家常软件”概念：只为自己和家人做的小程序
note.en: The classic essay on apps cooked just for yourself and loved ones

title.zh: 本地优先 + 端侧小模型的反云端软件
title.en: Local-First Software Powered by Tiny Edge Models

old_assumption.zh: 智能应用必须把用户数据传到云端、调用昂贵的大模型 API 并收取月度订阅费。
old_assumption.en: Smart apps must upload user data to the cloud, pay cloud LLM APIs, and charge monthly subscriptions.

new_shift.zh: 轻量级端侧视觉/语音/文本模型已经小到能在普通笔记本离线流畅运行，隐私敏感场景迎来“零 API 成本”的一次性买断新机会。
new_shift.en: Tiny open vision/audio/text models now run offline on consumer laptops, unlocking privacy-first, zero-API-cost software.

zh: 列出 5 个用户极度在意隐私、不敢上传云端的 [某领域，如医疗/财务/个人日记] 场景，设计一个完全离线运行、结合端侧小模型的本地优先工具。
对比云端大模型 API 与本地小模型（如 Whisper/Moondream/Qwen 小参数版），在 [具体使用场景] 中，如何通过任务拆解让端侧小模型达到 90% 的可用效果？
en: List 5 privacy-sensitive workflows in [Domain, e.g., finance/health/journaling] where users refuse cloud uploads, and design an offline local-first tool using tiny edge models.
For [Specific Use Case], how can I decompose the task so a small local model (Whisper/Moondream/small LLM) hits 90% accuracy with zero cloud API cost?

note.zh: 极致轻量的开源端侧视觉理解模型，可本地离线运行
note.en: Tiny open-source vision model built to run anywhere on-device

note.zh: Ink & Switch 提出的本地优先软件架构宣言
note.en: Ink & Switch's foundational essay on local-first architecture

title.zh: 无界面 / 隐形自动化（Zero-UI Automation）

old_assumption.zh: 好工具必须有精美的控制台和仪表盘，让用户每天点开操作。
old_assumption.en: Good tools need polished dashboards that you open and operate every day.

new_shift.zh: 最高级的个人工具根本没有界面——它藏在快捷键、文件夹监听或后台脚本里，平时完全隐身，只在异常时才提醒你。
new_shift.en: The best personal tools have no UI at all—they live in hotkeys, folder watchers, and background scripts, staying invisible until an exception needs you.

zh: 盘点我每天在电脑上重复超过 3 次的机械操作：[列出 2-3 个具体动作]。帮我把它们改造成“零界面后台自动化”（如文件夹监听、全局快捷键、定时脚本），并给出最小实现方案。
如果把 [你常用的某个效率工具/流程] 的图形界面全部砍掉，只保留“触发条件 → 自动执行 → 异常通知”三步，它的极简工作流应该怎么设计？
en: Audit these repetitive computer actions I do 3+ times a day: [List 2-3 Actions]. Redesign them as zero-UI background automations (folder watchers, hotkeys, cron scripts) with a minimal implementation plan.
If you stripped the entire GUI from [Workflow/Tool You Use] and kept only 'trigger -> silent execution -> exception alert', what would the minimal pipeline look like?

note.zh: macOS 经典无界面文件自动化工具，规则配好后几乎无需再打开
note.en: Classic macOS ambient file automation that runs silently once configured

note.zh: 用全局快捷键触发任意本地脚本，把重型操作压缩成 1 秒肌肉记忆
note.en: Trigger local scripts via global hotkeys, turning heavy workflows into 1-second muscle memory

title.zh: 用私人脚本给大厂网页打“外挂补丁”
title.en: Patching Annoying Web Apps with Personal Userscripts

old_assumption.zh: 每天高频使用的网站难用、信息杂乱或少个导出按钮，只能忍着等官方更新。
old_assumption.en: If a web app you use daily has cluttered UI or lacks an export button, you just have to live with it.

new_shift.zh: AI 写浏览器脚本的成本趋近于零，任何人都能花 5 分钟在本地隐藏噪音、注入快捷键或一键导出数据，把别人的软件改成自己的形状。
new_shift.en: AI makes writing userscripts and tiny browser extensions effortless—spend 5 minutes to hide noise, add hotkeys, or inject export buttons into any site you use.

zh: 我每天都要用 [某个网站/Web 系统]，但它最让我烦躁的 2 个问题是：[描述痛点，如侧边栏太吵/缺少一键复制/翻页麻烦]。请帮我写一个极简 Tampermonkey 油猴脚本，直接在本地修复这些体验。
列出 5 个你在 [某高频网站，如 GitHub/B站/Notion/邮箱] 上最值得用 50 行 JS 脚本改造的“反人性交互”，并按提效幅度排序。
en: I use [Specific Website/Web App] every day, and two things drive me crazy: [List Friction Points]. Write a minimal Tampermonkey userscript to patch these locally.
List 5 high-leverage micro-patches (under 50 lines of JS each) that dramatically improve daily usability on [Frequent Site, e.g., GitHub/Gmail/YouTube].

note.zh: “可塑软件”理念：用户应当能像改造房间一样自由微调自己使用的软件
note.en: The vision that users should be able to reshape the software they use to fit their own needs

title.zh: 把个人生活数据当作“私有上下文 API”来运维
title.en: Treating Personal Life Data as a Private Context API

old_assumption.zh: 笔记、账单、阅读、健康记录散落在十几个商业 App 里，想复盘只能人工来回翻。
old_assumption.en: Notes, expenses, reading logs, and health data stay trapped across a dozen separate commercial apps.

new_shift.zh: 借鉴企业数据中台思路，把个人高频数据定期沉淀到本地纯文本或 SQLite，让任何 AI 随时能安全读取你的“个人上下文”来辅助决策。
new_shift.en: Borrowing from enterprise data pipelines, syncing your key personal records into local Markdown or SQLite lets any AI reason over your real life context privately.

zh: 我想把目前分散在 [列出你常用的 3 个 App，如微信读书/记账软件/Apple Health] 的个人数据，定期同步到本地纯文本/SQLite 形成我的“私有上下文库”。请帮我设计一个极简、低维护的目录结构与同步方案。
如果我把过去半年的 [某类个人记录，如消费/日程/学习笔记] 整理成结构化文本喂给 AI，请设计 5 个平时我自己绝对看不出来的“跨维度复盘提问”。
en: I want to sync my scattered data from [List 3 Apps, e.g., Kindle/Expense Tracker/Calendar] into a local Markdown/SQLite personal context store. Design a minimal, low-maintenance folder structure and sync workflow.
Once I feed 6 months of structured [Type of Personal Log] to an AI, give me 5 cross-dimensional review prompts that reveal patterns I would never spot manually.

note.zh: 开源个人数据聚合接口，将个人各类数字足迹统一变成可编程本地数据
note.en: Open-source Python interface unifying personal digital footprints into programmable local data

title.zh: 把非结构化文档当作“源码”编译成结构化系统
title.en: Treating Unstructured Docs as Source Code Compiled into Systems

old_assumption.zh: 长文档、会议纪要、PDF 规则书和邮件只能写给人看，改了之后靠人工通知同步。
old_assumption.en: Specs, memos, PDFs, and emails are static text for humans—changes stay synced by manual reminders.

new_shift.zh: 把自然语言规则/文档当成“源码”，用 AI 流水线自动编译成 JSON 配置、测试断言、任务清单或日程变更，文档改了系统自动跟着变。
new_shift.en: Treat prose specs and notes as source code that compiles via LLM pipelines into JSON rules, test assertions, tasks, or calendar updates.

zh: 我有一类经常更新的文本/规则文档：[描述文档类型，如项目需求/报销规则/读书笔记]。请帮我设计一个“文档 → 结构化数据/任务清单”的自动提取与校验流水线。
在 [你的个人或团队工作流] 中，哪些“改了文档却忘了改配置/代码/待办”的同步断层，最适合用轻量脚本 + AI 校验来消除？
en: I maintain frequently updated prose docs like [Spec/Policy/Notes]. Design a pipeline that compiles them into structured JSON, checklists, or test rules with drift checks.
In [Your Workflow], where do docs and downstream configs/tasks drift out of sync, and how can a lightweight script + LLM check keep them aligned?

note.zh: 用结构化 Schema 约束大模型输出，让文本能稳定驱动下游工具
note.en: Constrained structured outputs turn natural language into reliable downstream program inputs

title.zh: 给危险或高成本动作加一层“本地沙盒预演”
title.en: Adding a Local Dry-Run Sandbox Before High-Stakes Actions

old_assumption.zh: 批量改文件、群发消息、调外部接口或跑自动化脚本，要么小心翼翼手动点，要么出事了才后悔。
old_assumption.en: Batch file edits, bulk sends, or automation scripts either get clicked painfully by hand or break things in production.

new_shift.zh: 先在本地临时目录或“只打印计划不执行（Dry-Run）”模式下跑一遍预览与差异对比，确认无误再放行，极大降低自动化焦虑。
new_shift.en: Running a dry-run preview with clear diffs in a temp folder before real execution removes the fear of automation mistakes.

zh: 我打算写一个自动处理 [文件整理/数据清洗/批量修改] 的脚本，最怕误删或改错。请帮我设计标准的 `--dry-run` 预览与备份回滚机制。
盘点我最容易“手滑点错或批量改崩”的 3 个电脑操作，如何用极简的预演/确认步骤把容错率拉满？
en: I'm automating [File Cleanup/Data Transform/Batch Edit] and fear accidental data loss. Design a clean `--dry-run` diff preview and rollback safety net.
List 3 computer tasks where a slip-up hurts most, and add a fast preview/confirmation guard that keeps speed high and risk low.

note.zh: 隔离工作区与预演机制是工程界对抗“改坏现状”最朴素也最可靠的护栏
note.en: Isolated workspaces and dry-run previews are simple, battle-tested guards against unintended changes

title.zh: 用“声明式配置/脚本”替代靠记忆点 20 步界面
title.en: Replacing 20-Click Menus with Declarative Configs & Scripts

old_assumption.zh: 换电脑、重装环境或改一套配置，只能凭印象在设置面板里一步步点回去。
old_assumption.en: Setting up a new machine or tweaking a workflow means clicking through 20 menu screens from memory.

new_shift.zh: 把偏好、环境依赖和常用组合写成一份可读的配置文件或脚本，重装、迁移和分享都能一键复现，再也不怕忘掉当初怎么配出来的。
new_shift.en: Capturing preferences, setups, and shortcuts in declarative configs or scripts makes new machines, rollbacks, and sharing reproducible in seconds.

zh: 列出我每次换设备或重装时最容易漏掉的 5 个环境/工具配置项：[填入你的常用环境或工具]。帮我设计一份可版本管理的极简配置清单或一键初始化脚本思路。
在 [你日常使用的某个软件/工作流] 中，哪些“靠手动勾选、记笔记”的设置其实可以沉淀成模板或配置，省去重复劳动？
en: List 5 setup items I easily forget when switching machines or environments for [Your Stack/Tools], and design a versionable checklist or bootstrap script plan.
In [Tool or Workflow You Use], what manual settings or repetitive clicks can be captured as a reusable config or template instead?

note.zh: 把个人环境配置放进版本控制，让换机与回滚变得可追踪、可复现
note.en: Keeping personal environment configs in version control makes setups reproducible and reversible

title.zh: 让自动化只在“关键决策卡点”停下来等人确认
title.en: Pausing Automation Only at High-Stakes Decision Gates

old_assumption.zh: 自动化要么是“全自动无人值守”，要么是“每一步都弹窗问人”，两者都很别扭。
old_assumption.en: Automation feels like an all-or-nothing choice between blind autonomy and annoying step-by-step prompts.

new_shift.zh: 最顺手的人机协作是：前 90% 的搜集、清洗、草拟全自动跑完，只在涉及对外发送、花钱、删改或高风险判断时留一个清晰确认点。
new_shift.en: The sweet spot is automated research, drafting, and prep—pausing cleanly only before external sends, spend, destructive actions, or high-judgment calls.

zh: 我想把 [某个半自动工作流，如整理信息/起草回复/生成方案] 交给 AI 或脚本跑。请帮我画出“自动执行段”和“必须停下来让我确认的 1～2 个关键卡点”。
针对 [你最担心的自动化翻车场景]，设计一种“低打扰但足够安全”的确认与兜底机制，既不天天弹框烦人又能挡住致命错误。
en: I'm automating [Workflow, e.g., research triage/drafting/planning]. Map what runs automatically vs. the 1–2 decision gates where it should pause for my sign-off.
For [High-Risk Automation Scenario], design a low-noise approval or fallback guard that prevents costly mistakes without constant interruptions.

note.zh: 在关键动作前设置显式确认与护栏，是提升自主工作流可靠性的核心实践
note.en: Explicit human checkpoints before consequential actions keep autonomous workflows trustworthy

title.zh: 给高频 Prompt / 工作流建一份“5 条样例评测集”
title.en: Building a 5-Case Eval Set Before Tweaking Prompts

old_assumption.zh: 改完提示词或工作流，顺手拿手头这一条测一下顺眼就行。
old_assumption.en: After editing a prompt or workflow, testing it on one sample that looks good is enough.

new_shift.zh: 单条样例很容易陷入“修好 A 搞坏 B”；固定 3～5 条典型+刁钻样例做对照，每次改动都能一眼看出是真变强还是只是偏科。
new_shift.en: Testing on one example lets regressions slip through—keeping 3–5 tricky benchmark cases shows whether a tweak actually improves reliability.

zh: 我有一个高频使用的 [Prompt/工作流/自动化规则]：[简述用途]。请帮我设计 4 条覆盖常规、边界与刁钻情况的测试样例，以及一条客观的评分标准。
在 [你的 AI 使用场景] 中，哪些“改了之后偶尔抽风”的提示词最值得先建一套最小评测集再做优化？
en: I have a high-frequency [Prompt, Workflow, or Rule]: [Brief Purpose]. Design 4 test cases (normal, edge, and tricky) plus a clear pass/fail rubric.
In [Your AI Workflow], which prompts or automations drift unexpectedly and would benefit most from a small benchmark set before further tuning?

note.zh: 从真实错误案例中提炼小而精的评测样例，比凭空猜指标更管用
note.en: Small eval sets grounded in real failure cases beat abstract metrics in daily iteration

title.zh: 把核心资产存成“纯文本/JSON”，不被单一工具绑架
title.en: Storing Core Assets in Plain Text & JSON Instead of Walled Gardens

old_assumption.zh: 把笔记、清单和方案全塞进某个热门 App 的私有格式里，方便又省事。
old_assumption.en: Putting notes, trackers, and docs inside a proprietary app's lock-in format is easiest.

new_shift.zh: 工具会涨价、改版、关停或换代，但 Markdown、CSV 和 JSON 跨越几十年依然能被任何编辑器、脚本和 AI 直接读写。
new_shift.en: Tools change pricing, redesign, or shut down—Markdown, CSV, and JSON remain readable by any editor, script, or AI for decades.

zh: 我目前把 [某类重要资料/笔记/清单] 放在 [某个软件或平台] 里。请帮我设计一套导出与落盘为 Markdown / JSON 的结构方案，兼顾可读性与脚本可处理性。
如何让“平时顺手写在某个工具里”和“定期沉淀成跨工具可复用的纯文本/JSON”不变成两张皮？
en: I currently keep [Notes, Trackers, or Docs] inside [App/Platform]. Design a clean Markdown or JSON representation that stays human-readable and script-friendly.
How can I keep quick daily capture effortless while ensuring important records stay portable in plain text or JSON?

note.zh: 文件大于软件：让数据文件成为长期主体，软件只是随时可替换的窗口
note.en: File over app: your files outlive any single app when stored in durable open formats

title.zh: 把大脚本拆成“单一职责的小模块”，靠管道拼装而不是硬写巨石
title.en: Composing Small Single-Purpose Scripts Over Monolithic Automation

old_assumption.zh: 写自动化时习惯把抓取、清洗、判断、输出全塞进一个几百行的庞大脚本里。
old_assumption.en: Automations often bundle fetching, cleaning, filtering, and output into one giant script that's hard to debug or reuse.

new_shift.zh: 每个小模块只干好一件事、输入输出格式清晰，换一个数据源或换一个输出目标时，直接像积木一样重新拼装即可。
new_shift.en: Small tools that each do one job cleanly with clear inputs and outputs snap together like blocks when a source or destination changes.

zh: 我有一个偏臃肿的 [脚本/工作流/自动化任务]：[简述流程]。请帮我拆成 3～4 个职责单一的独立步骤，并定好它们之间传递数据的极简格式。
在 [你的日常自动化场景] 中，哪些“只做一件事的过滤/转换小工具”最值得单独抽出来，方便以后反复复用？
en: I have a sprawling [Script or Workflow]: [Brief Flow]. Break it into 3–4 single-purpose steps with a clean data format passed between them.
In [Your Automation Setup], which small filter or formatter step is worth pulling out as a standalone reusable block?

signals.name: Unix Philosophy — Do One Thing Well

note.zh: 单一职责与标准文本/数据流组合，让小工具拥有极高的复用性与可维护性
note.en: Single-purpose tools linked by clean data streams stay easy to test, swap, and reuse

title.zh: 给 AI 能力配“确定性兜底”，别让偶尔抽风卡死整条流程
title.en: Pairing AI Steps with Deterministic Fallbacks Instead of Brittle Chains

old_assumption.zh: 既然引入了 AI，就让模型从头包揽所有解析、分类和格式化。
old_assumption.en: Once AI is in the loop, let the model handle parsing, routing, and formatting end-to-end every time.

new_shift.zh: 确定性规则能搞定的事别交给概率模型；AI 拿不到预期格式或超时时，自动走规则兜底或跳过留待人工，整条流水线就不会轻易瘫痪。
new_shift.en: Keep deterministic rules where rules suffice, and add clean fallbacks when AI outputs miss format or time out so the whole pipeline keeps moving.

zh: 我有一个依赖 AI 输出的 [工作流/脚本/工具]：[简述用途]，偶尔会出现格式不对或结果偏差。请帮我设计一套“先规则/校验，不行再降级兜底”的安全方案。
审视 [你的某个 AI 应用或工作流]，指出哪两个环节最适合用传统确定性逻辑分担，减少模型的负担与不确定性？
en: My [Workflow or Tool] relies on AI output—[Brief Purpose]—and occasionally slips on format or edge cases. Design a clean validation and fallback path.
Inspect [Your AI Workflow] and point out 2 steps where deterministic rules can share the load and make behavior steadier.

note.zh: 结合校验与优雅降级，能让含 AI 环节的系统在真实使用中更稳健
note.en: Combining schema checks with graceful fallbacks keeps real-world workflows resilient

title.zh: 给脚本和工作流留“结构化痕迹”，出事时 1 分钟定位
title.en: Leaving Structured Traces So Failures Take 1 Minute to Diagnose

old_assumption.zh: 小工具或自动化平时能跑通就行，出错了再临时加打印或靠猜。
old_assumption.en: Small scripts and workflows only need to run when things go right—debug errors by guessing later.

new_shift.zh: 记录关键输入摘要、耗时、跳过原因与最后成功状态，一旦哪天静默失效或结果异常，立刻能顺藤摸瓜找到根因。
new_shift.en: Recording input counts, skip reasons, timings, and last-good state turns mysterious silent failures into a 1-minute root-cause check.

zh: 我有一个日常跑的 [脚本/自动化/工作流]：[简述流程]。帮我设计一套轻量日志与运行摘要格式，既不会把盘塞爆，又能让我在出错时快速定位原因。
在 [你的个人工具或自动化场景] 中，哪些“静默失败（没报错但结果不对）”最隐蔽？如何加一个简单自检提示？
en: I run [Script, Automation, or Workflow]: [Brief Flow]. Design a lightweight run-log format that stays compact while making failures easy to trace.
In [Your Tools or Automations], what kind of 'silent failure' (no crash, wrong result) is hardest to notice, and how can a simple sanity check catch it?

note.zh: 清晰的上下文记录与运行摘要，是降低日常排错成本的高回报习惯
note.en: Clear run summaries and context logs cut debugging time dramatically even in small personal tools

title.zh: 把每天高频切换的 3 个动作绑成顺手快捷键
title.en: Binding Your Top 3 Daily Context Switches to Effortless Hotkeys

old_assumption.zh: 每次打开特定工具、查特定资料或切窗口，多点几下鼠标、多翻几层菜单也差不了几秒。
old_assumption.en: Clicking through menus or hunting windows for frequent tasks only takes a few seconds each time.

new_shift.zh: 每天几十次的微摩擦加起来就是一整块专注力与时间；把最常用的 3 个入口绑成直达快捷键，动作变顺手后使用频率也会自然提高。
new_shift.en: Dozens of tiny micro-frictions add up every day—binding your top 3 recurring actions to instant hotkeys saves time and makes good habits easier to trigger.

zh: 盘点我每天在电脑上最常重复打开或切换的 5 个窗口/工具/动作：[填入你的高频操作]。帮我挑出最值得优先设快捷键的 3 个，并给出无冲突的按键组合建议。
在 [你的常用编辑器/终端/浏览器/启动器] 中，有哪些能把“多步操作”压成“一键触发”的实用小配置？
en: Here are 5 windows, tools, or actions I open or switch to constantly: [List 5 Actions]. Pick the top 3 to bind to shortcuts and suggest conflict-free key combos.
In [Your Editor, Terminal, Browser, or Launcher], what quick config turns a multi-step sequence into a single instant trigger?

note.zh: 减少鼠标往返与菜单寻找，让高频操作接近“想到即触发”
note.en: Cutting menu hunting and mouse detours brings frequent actions close to instant recall

title.zh: 用“显式状态机”约束 Agent 流转，而不是放任自由循环
title.en: Constraining Agent Flows with Explicit State Machines Over Open Loops

old_assumption.zh: 让 Agent 自己决定下一步干什么、循环到满意为止，最接近“真正自主”。
old_assumption.en: Letting an agent freely loop and improvise every next step until it feels done is the most autonomous design.

new_shift.zh: 无界循环容易死循环、烧光预算或偏离轨道；把关键阶段锁进明确状态转移（草稿 → 校验 → 确认 → 执行），自主性更高且可控性呈数量级提升。
new_shift.en: Unbounded loops burn tokens and drift—locking stages into explicit state transitions (draft → verify → approve → act) gives real reliability without losing leverage.

zh: 我有一个多步 [AI 工作流 / Agent 任务]：[简述输入、中间步骤与期望结果]。请帮我画出它的核心状态节点与允许跳转的条件，标出最容易卡死或越界的转移边。
如果把 [你正在搭的某个自动化流程] 改造成带“显式状态与重试上限”的有限状态机，哪些步骤应该允许自动重试，哪些必须直接失败上报？
en: I'm building a multi-step [AI Workflow or Agent Task]: [Describe Inputs, Steps & Target Output]. Map its core states and valid transitions, highlighting where loops or drift can happen.
If I model [My Automation Flow] as an explicit state machine with retry caps, which steps should auto-retry vs. fail fast for human inspection?

note.zh: 强调在自主度与结构化编排之间做务实取舍，比堆砌复杂自由循环更稳健
note.en: Pragmatic workflow structure and clear boundaries outperform uncontrolled loops in production
